    Rays act by zero on simple modules #

    A nonzero non-invertible morphism f of a finite ray category acts by zero on every simple k(P)-module (morElt_smul_simple): otherwise f s = f b f s for some b, and the composites f ν f have larger depth (downward induction on depth). Hence homogeneous elements of nontrivial degree kill simple modules (smul_simple_of_ne_one), and every graded-indecomposable projective has a graded maximal submodule (rayGrRadHyp).
